$comment: What a DS1 Multi Randomizer release contains and what must be signed. Paths are relative to the unpacked app folder (apps/desktop/release/win-unpacked). Edited by hand, read by release-verify.mjs and release-gate.mjs.

ds1trExecutables.role: the Electron application (renamed electron.exe, DS1TR resources and icon)
DsrDataTool: reads and patches the game files into a workspace (self-contained .NET, single file, not compressed)
ds1trExecutables.launchedAs: child process of the backend, arguments array, no shell

ds1trExecutables.role: FogHost: runs the fog randomizer (FogMod) on the prepared data (self-contained .NET, single file, not compressed)
ds1trExecutables.launchedAs: child process of the backend, arguments array, no shell

ds1trExecutables.role: frozen FogHost 0.5.0 for generation profiles v1 and v2 (source pinned by commit and tree)
ds1trExecutables.launchedAs: profile-selected child process of the backend, arguments array, no shell

ds1trExecutables.role: optional Windows game cursor watcher, only when enabled (self-contained .NET, single file, not compressed)
ds1trExecutables.launchedAs: child process of Electron main, piped stdin, no shell

installedExtras.role: the uninstaller the installer writes (checked after an install, not inside the unpacked folder)

thirdPartyBinaries.owner: Electron / Chromium (Dawn custom build; unsigned in Electron 44.7.0)

forbiddenBinaries.why: a UAC elevation helper of the installer toolchain; DS1TR runs as the invoking user and never elevates, so it is not shipped
